patterns.note: The homepage employs an asymmetrical layout with large, full-width content blocks for hero sections and carousels, interspersed with more structured grids for art displays.
A striking contrast is created between oversized, elegant serif typography for primary headings and display text, and clean, smaller sans-serif fonts for body copy and labels.
A sophisticated, muted palette of light beige backgrounds, dark brown/black text, and occasional terracotta accents creates a luxurious and earthy feel.
The provided scroll sequence only displays a static 'click to enter' pre-loader screen; no scroll-triggered motion or reveals are observable on the main homepage content from these frames.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical whitespace and distinct background treatments or full-bleed imagery, creating a deliberate, unhurried browsing experience.

technique_notes: The site features an initial 'click to enter' splash screen that serves as a gateway to the main content.

Image galleries and featured sections utilize a full-width carousel system for browsing content, with clear navigation arrows and pagination dots, suggesting interactive sliding animations (indicated by 'swiper' tech hint).
Sections are visually separated by generous vertical spacing and distinct content blocks, often featuring large, elegant typography as primary visual anchors.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (display ~5-8x body) with clean, smaller sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements having crisp corners and no visible rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical and horizontal whitespace, creating a luxurious and unhurried feel between elements and sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, elegant serif typography for headings and display elements, combined with a 'click to enter' splash screen, creates a luxurious and exclusive gallery experience that feels more like an art book than a typical website.
